``` {.python .cell-code}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 120.0
PROBE_SPENT = 120.0

import aerosandbox as asb
import aerosandbox.numpy as np
from IPython.display import Markdown

opt = optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False)
c_root, taper, cg_x = get_base_3mm_params(opt)

# Base airplane
airplane_base = make_glider_3mm(c_root, taper, cg_x)
mac = float(airplane_base.wings[0].mean_aerodynamic_chord())
op = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=10, alpha=5)

derivs_base = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane_base, op).run_with_stability_derivatives()
np_base = float(derivs_base['x_np'][0])

# Swept back 15 degrees
tip_sweep = 0.15 * np.tan(np.radians(15))
wing_swept = asb.Wing(
    name="Wing", symmetric=True,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0, 0, 0], chord=c_root, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca4403")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[tip_sweep, 0.15, 0], chord=c_root * taper, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca4403"))
    ]
)
air_swept = asb.Airplane(
    name="Swept wing (15°)", 
    xyz_ref=[cg_x, 0, 0], 
    wings=[wing_swept, airplane_base.wings[1], airplane_base.wings[2]], 
    fuselages=airplane_base.fuselages
)
derivs_swept = asb.AeroBuildup(air_swept, op).run_with_stability_derivatives()

# Extended boom (+50mm)
htail_long = asb.Wing(
    name="H-tail", symmetric=True,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.20, 0, 0], chord=0.03, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.20, 0.05, 0], chord=0.03, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003"))
    ]
)
vtail_long = asb.Wing(
    name="V-tail", symmetric=False,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.20, 0, 0], chord=0.03, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.20, 0, 0.05], chord=0.03, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003"))
    ]
)
air_boom = asb.Airplane(
    name="Longer boom (+50 mm)", 
    xyz_ref=[cg_x, 0, 0], 
    wings=[airplane_base.wings[0], htail_long, vtail_long], 
    fuselages=airplane_base.fuselages
)
derivs_boom = asb.AeroBuildup(air_boom, op).run_with_stability_derivatives()

# Enlarged tail (+50% chord)
htail_large = asb.Wing(
    name="H-tail", symmetric=True,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.15, 0, 0], chord=0.045, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[0.15, 0.05, 0], chord=0.045, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0003"))
    ]
)
air_tail = asb.Airplane(
    name="Larger tail (+50% chord)", 
    xyz_ref=[cg_x, 0, 0], 
    wings=[airplane_base.wings[0], htail_large, airplane_base.wings[2]], 
    fuselages=airplane_base.fuselages
)
derivs_tail = asb.AeroBuildup(air_tail, op).run_with_stability_derivatives()

rows = []
for air, derivs in [
    (airplane_base, derivs_base),
    (air_swept, derivs_swept),
    (air_boom, derivs_boom),
    (air_tail, derivs_tail)
]:
    x_np = float(derivs['x_np'][0])
    cma = float(derivs['Cma'][0])
    sm = (x_np - cg_x) / mac * 100
    rows.append({
        "Modification": air.name if air.name != "Glider" else "Base",
        "Neutral point (mm)": f"{x_np*1000:.1f}",
        "Static margin (%)": f"{sm:.1f}",
        "$C_{m_\\alpha}$ (1/rad)": f"{cma:.3f}"
    })

table_md = "| Modification | Neutral point (mm) | Static margin (%) | $C_{m_\\alpha}$ (1/rad) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
for r in rows:
    table_md += f"| {r['Modification']} | {r['Neutral point (mm)']} | {r['Static margin (%)']} | {r['$C_{m_\\alpha}$ (1/rad)']} |\n"
```
:::


**Answer.** To increase the pitch stability without shifting the center of gravity (which sits at [45\.3 mm]{.key}, ahead of the base neutral point at [49\.6 mm]{.key}), the neutral point must be moved further aft. 

Sweeping the wings backward by 15°, lengthening the tail boom by 50 mm, or increasing the horizontal tail chord by 50% all successfully push the neutral point further behind the CG. As shown below, each modification increases the static margin and results in a more strongly negative $C_{m_\alpha}$.

| Modification | Neutral point (mm) | Static margin (%) | $C_{m_\alpha}$ (1/rad) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | 49.6 | 5.2 | -0.263 |
| Swept wing (15°) | 53.8 | 10.2 | -0.519 |
| Longer boom (+50 mm) | 58.3 | 15.6 | -0.792 |
| Larger tail (+50% chord) | 50.7 | 6.5 | -0.332 |

## The method, as called

```python
def optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False):
    opti = asb.Opti()
    c_root = opti.variable(init_guess=0.08, lower_bound=0.01, upper_bound=0.15)
    taper = opti.variable(init_guess=0.5, lower_bound=0.1, upper_bound=1.0)
    alpha = opti.variable(init_guess=5, lower_bound=-5, upper_bound=15)
    V = opti.variable(init_guess=3, lower_bound=1, upper_bound=20)
    gamma = opti.variable(init_guess=-5, lower_bound=-45, upper_bound=45)
    cg_x = opti.variable(init_guess=0.03, lower_bound=-0.05, upper_bound=0.15)

    airplane = make_glider_3mm(c_root, taper, cg_x)
    aero = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=airplane, op_point=asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=V, alpha=alpha)).run()

    wings_area = airplane.wings[0].area() + airplane.wings[1].area() + airplane.wings[2].area()
    # area density of 3mm foam = 174.4 * (3/5) = 104.64 g/m^2
    area_density = 0.10464
    fuse_mass = (0.2 * 0.015) * 2 * area_density
    mass = wings_area * area_density + fuse_mass
    weight = mass * 9.81

    opti.subject_to([
        aero["L"] == weight * np.cosd(gamma),
        aero["D"] == weight * np.sind(-gamma),
        aero["Cm"] == 0
    ])

    sink_rate = V * np.sind(-gamma)
    opti.minimize(sink_rate)
    sol = opti.solve(verbose=verbose)
    
    return {
        "sol": sol,
        "sink_rate": sol.value(sink_rate),
        "c_root": sol.value(c_root),
        "taper": sol.value(taper),
        "cg_x": sol.value(cg_x),
        "alpha": sol.value(alpha),
        "mass": sol.value(mass)
    }

def get_base_3mm_params(opt=None):
    if opt is None:
        opt = optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False)
    return float(opt["c_root"]), float(opt["taper"]), float(opt["cg_x"])
```
